description: This file defines the ApiClient class, which provides methods for interacting with a backend API via HTTP requests. It handles GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE operations and manages authorization headers, base URL configuration from environment variables, and error handling. Additionally, it defines the ApiException class for handling API errors. The class is designed for use within a Flutter frontend application to facilitate backend communication.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A simple HTTP client for communicating with a backend API, supporting authentication, different HTTP methods, and error handling.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class thrown when API requests return non-success status codes.

methods.name: ApiClient({String? token})
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ApiClient with an optional token for authorization.

methods.name: setToken(String? token)
methods.description: Updates the bearer token used for authenticated requests.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Getter that retrieves the base URL from environment variables, throwing an exception if not set.

methods.name: _headers()
methods.description: Constructs headers for HTTP requests, including authorization if a token is set.

methods.name: get(String path, {Map<String, String>? query})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: getList(String path, {Map<String, String>? query})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request expected to return a list of items.

methods.name: post(String path, Map<String, dynamic> body)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with a JSON body.

methods.name: patch(String path, Map<String, dynamic> body)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with a JSON body.

methods.name: _ensureSuccess(http.Response res, {Set<int> expected})
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP response status code is in the expected set; throws an ApiException if not.
